tools.intro: SNPE belt exercise is more than simply fixing the body in place — it is a process of regaining the body's lost center and helping the body itself remember the sense of correct movement.

recommend.title: Recommended SNPE Tools
recommend.sub: Ceramics and rollers that provide additional stimulation beyond the basic tools.

belt.name: SNPE Correct Posture Belt
belt.desc: A non-elastic leg belt that stably aligns the lower body and pelvis.

pelvicBand.name: Pelvic Band
pelvicBand.desc: An elastic band that stably supports the pelvis and hip joints.

wavePillow.name: Wave Pillow
wavePillow.desc: A wave-shaped pillow designed for the spinal curve that gently releases muscles across a wide area.

danason.name: Danason
danason.desc: A finger-shaped acupressure tool that locally releases stiff areas.

ovalCeramic.name: Oval Ceramic
ovalCeramic.desc: An oval-shaped ceramic warmed to provide deep, focused release on the neck, back, waist, or abdomen.

twoRail.name: Two Rail
twoRail.desc: A rail-type self-care tool that simultaneously delivers compression and release along the spine and fascial lines.

waveRoller2.name: Wave Roller (2 nodes)
waveRoller2.desc: A self myofascial release tool that, like teeth alignment, applies progressive movement to displaced and stiff spine.

dokkaebi.name: Dokkaebi Hand
dokkaebi.desc: A tool that gently releases tension in stiffened muscles and fascia, letting members feel their body's changes.

waveRoller.name: Wave Roller (4 nodes)
waveRoller.desc: A self myofascial release tool that, like teeth alignment, applies progressive movement to displaced and stiff spine.

waveStick.name: Wave Stick
waveStick.desc: A self-care tool that comfortably releases deep tension in the neck, back, waist, and abdomen with warming heat and weighted pressure.

eightCells.name: 8-Node Roller
eightCells.desc: Six finger-shaped pressure points reach deep knots that hands cannot reach.

doubleFoamRoller.name: Double Foam Roller
doubleFoamRoller.desc: Recommended for myofascial release before and after exercise, offering stable support and deep release across a wide surface.
